npcs.name: Kent Connol
npcs.description: Kent Connol is a Gnome radio dramatist whose belief in masked heroes is embarrassing, contagious, and more politically dangerous than anyone expects. He writes morality plays, crime serials, and coded broadcasts for the Brass Concordat, using melodrama to remind frightened listeners that cruelty is not the same thing as strength. Kent is anxious but brave when cornered, and his stories sometimes inspire people to do the right thing before he is ready to survive the consequences.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Élarwyn is a Town in Khorvaak, under Scholar-Bureaucracy, with moderate danger, Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water, Farming terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Gnome reads through the Deep Gnome entry of the race compendium, within Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, marked by Marduthor. Deep gnomes, or svirfneblin, are adapted to life in the deep subterranean world. They are cautious, stealthy, and highly resourceful in dangerous underground environments. Table cues: Gnome, Darkvision, Gift of the Svirfneblin, Gnomish Magic Resistance; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Neutral - Honorable.
rumors: Kent hides real crime tips inside ridiculous radio villain monologues.
Children in three districts can quote his hero oath better than they can name their councilor.
plotHooks: Kent asks the party to act out a staged broadcast that draws a real murderer into the open.
A crime boss kidnaps Kent after realizing his latest episode describes an unsolved killing too accurately.

npcs.name: Nessa Crashborn
npcs.description: Nessa Crashborn is a sharp-clawed Kobold salvage leader who treats every wreck, collapsed skyship, and broken cargo hold like a crime scene with treasure buried under the bones. Fae is guarded, territorial, and slow to trust, shaped by a burned past, a ruined family line, and the hard lesson that greed can turn a home into ashes faster than fire. At the Élarwyn Archive, Nessa works with the Brass Concordat to decode old flight manifests, smuggling ledgers, crash records, and sealed cargo claims before scavengers, raiders, or ichor smugglers strip the evidence clean. Fae leads with a growl and expects faer crew to survive through discipline, loyalty, and combined strength, but beneath the suspicion is a fierce protector who will risk everything for anyone fae has decided is pack.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Élarwyn is a Town in Khorvaak, under Scholar-Bureaucracy, with moderate danger, Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water, Farming terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Kobold reads through the Kobold entry of the race compendium, within Draconic and Reptilian Races, marked by Valkhamesh. Kobolds are small draconic kin known for ingenuity, trapmaking, and pack survival. They often revere dragons as divine figures and adapt quickly to danger. Table cues: Darkvision, Draconic Cry, Kobold Legacy; starting tendency Selfish - Lawful - Cooperative - Honorable.
rumors: Nessa Crashborn knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Anubaday.
Nessa Crashborn has a contact in Sylvanreach who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Nessa Crashborn asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Nessa Crashborn's public story is incomplete.

npcs.name: Scribe Paelyn Jannar
npcs.description:
Scribe Paelyn Jannar is a brilliant, excitable Tiefling field scribe with a mind built for impossible engineering, skyship math, aetheric propulsion, and the terrifying sentence, “That should not be possible, which means it is extremely interesting.” They/her is awkward, curious, optimistic, and far braver than she looks, especially when an ichor-powered device, broken relic engine, or unstable simulation lattice threatens to erase someone from reality.
At the Élarwyn Guild Desk, Paelyn documents Crucible field tests, failed prototypes, launch calculations, memory-lattice incidents, and dangerous ichor contamination events that other Custodians would rather bury in sealed reports. She is deeply devoted to her spouse, Archivist Thiblee Jannar, and the two are a perfect disaster pair: Thiblee pushes the glowing button, Paelyn figures out why the room is now upside down, and both insist the findings were scientifically valuable.

Tiefling reads through the Tiefling entry of the race compendium, within Celestial, Fiendish, and Planar Bloodlines, marked by Freyseth. Tieflings are fiend-touched humanoids marked by infernal ancestry and social stigma. They often develop strong individuality and resilience in the face of prejudice. Table cues: Darkvision, Fiendish Legacy, Otherworldly Presence; starting tendency Neutral - Chaotic - Neutral - Neutral.
